note: Pre-registered strategies. Frozen on frozen_at; do not change parameters. Chosen as the only distinct rules (of 2,352 strategy x filter x stadium cells, model-only, decidable before the race) with ROI > 100% in BOTH the selection period (2024-02-03..2025-12-31) and the test period (2026-01-01..2026-11-17), each with >= 40 races. Selected from many candidates on past data, so chance is a likely explanation; only results on races from frozen_at onward count. S4 was added on 2026-11-19 from a separate bet-type analysis (few comparisons; the edge held in both halves of 2026 with the lower 95% bound above 100%).

strategies.name: Favourite trio, 1 ticket (top win prob 30-40%, gap >= 20%)
Top-3 by P(top-3) box, 1 ticket (top win prob 30-40%, gap >= 20%)
Omura only: top-3 by P(top-3) box, 1 ticket (top win prob 20-30%)
Win bet on the model's top boat when it is not the market favourite
strategies.how_to_use: Before the deadline, check the win odds in the betting app; buy the model's top boat (shown on the board) only if another boat has the lowest win odds. Tracking uses the closing odds.

evidence.note: Found in a bet-type analysis after the S1-S3 search; overall 2026: 933 races, ROI 119.9% (95% CI 109.8-130.8); Tokuyama 127%, Ashiya 115%, Omura 116%. The favourite is taken from closing odds, which are not known before the deadline.
